results.title: The CLOSETocracy
results.overview: Bombshell documentary features firsthand accounts from three men alleging paid sexual encounters with the late senator, Lindsey Graham, and examines the contrast between his alleged private conduct and public opposition to LGBTQ+ rights.

results.title: A Knock at the Door
results.overview: As three best friends, Jamie, Archie, and Quinn, kick back and relax for a cozy movie night, they are interrupted by an unexpected—and possibly deadly—knock at the door! The three must decide whether to fight back or succumb to the fear when it is determined that the visit could be connected to a gruesome string of murders in the next town over. Should they hide? Should they call the police? Should they PREPARE THEIR CHAINSAW FOR WAR??!

results.title: Frozen Lands
results.overview: In hopes to get his friend Tak out of a deep depression, Tom takes him along for a job in the far North. Beautiful and untamed landscapes unfold before them, but as they make their way, night falls, rain pours down and the polar ground crumbles. Alone together on the road, amid silences and tensions, they confront expectations and the quiet complexities of friendship.

results.title: The Changing City
results.overview: Completed in 100 hours for DocsMX’s Short Truth Challenge 2026. Through interviews with environmentalists, it is narrated how humans have promoted climate change and its effects in the city of San Luis Potosí.

results.title: A Nightmare on Felt Street
results.overview: Awkward puppeteer Henry and his faithful puppet best friend Blue return home to hear the reading of his overbearing father's will

results.title: La línea del mar
results.overview: In a small town on Colombia’s Pacific coast, five young people spend their days by the sea. They walk, talk, and sit in silence, while time seems to stand still and the landscape becomes part of their friendship. As the ocean advances, an inevitable farewell looms.

results.title: Poké Wayang: The Forest Where "Good Morning" Disappeared
results.original_title: Poké Wayang: Hutan Tanpa Selamat Pagi
results.overview: Well, here we are in Sunrise Forest... But wait, something seems a bit strange.

results.title: Lou Sanders - No Kissing in the Bingo Hall: Live
results.original_title: Lou Sanders - No Kissing in the Bingo Hall: Live
results.overview: Taskmaster Champion and Last One Laughing non champion Lou Sanders delivers a riotous, joke-packed stand up special about love (where is it), mini trampolines (would recommend) and trying to sneak into Business Class on a BA flight.

results.title: Touching Base
results.overview: Taylor Fisher is a recently 'on-boarded' 'high-flyer' and he's ready to climb the corporate ladder, he's all prepped for his meeting but there's a problem when nature calls...

results.title: 1936 : El Año que se Perdió el Miedo al Poder
results.original_title: 1936 : El Año que se Perdió el Miedo al Poder
results.overview: The feature-length documentary on the historic year of 1936 in Venezuela: the first year of Eleazar López Contreras's government, following the death of Juan Vicente Gómez and 27 years of dictatorship. A film that shows, like never before, a portrait of the Venezuelan people and of a changing society. 90 years later, this documentary—an unprecedented historical audiovisual record—recreates an image of the past that is unique in its kind for Venezuelan historiography.

results.title: The Last Dance In Kippur
results.overview: ON OCTOBER 6, 1973, THE EGYPTIAN ARMED FORCES CHALLENGED THOSE EXPECTATIONS AND CHANGED THE COURSE OF HISTORY.  THE LAST DANCE IN KIPPUR IS A CINEMATIC RECREATION OF THE CRITICAL HOURS LEADING UP TO THE OCTOBER WAR, EXPLORING MILITARY STRATEGY, INTELLIGENCE, DECEPTION, AND THE EXTRAORDINARY COURAGE OF THE EGYPTIAN SOLDIER.

results.title: 500mL
results.overview: During a single, chaotic night inside a pounding nightclub, two desperate young parents risk everything to change their futures. The stakes turn fatal when a drug deal, a debt, and a baby left alone at home collide with devastating consequences.

results.title: Fokus
results.overview: Jaana, a top coach at the elite club Fokus, suffers a medical emergency under mysterious circumstances, leaving Olympic hopeful Tove in need of a new coach. When former star skater Miina returns to the club, a quest for revenge ignites a volatile power struggle in which no one’s reputation is safe.  *Fokus* is an intense miniseries set in the glittering yet harsh world of figure skating.

results.title: Three Sad Aunts
results.overview: What begins as a true-crime drama about three women — one imprisoned during a dictatorship, another who fled Brazil, and a third who took her own life — shifts when their nephew, now a father and the film’s director, steps in and questions his own narrative. Through archival footage and journeys, he seeks to reunite his family while his children teach him a new way of looking toward the future.

results.title: Du Fria
results.overview: Emily appears to be an ordinary property manager, but she harbours a deep-rooted desire for revenge. In a forgotten basement at her workplace, she holds Chris captive – the son of the man who destroyed her life.

results.title: Distance
results.overview: Originally published in The Memory Palace by Nate DiMeo, Distance is a short-animated film that tells the story of Samuel Finley Breese Morse. His years as a painter, his personal story, and the path that led him to help shape one of the most important inventions in modern communication.  This project began as one of Ordinary Folk’s earliest passion pieces in 2020. It went through multiple visual explorations and experiments, guided by a long list of talented collaborators. The final film contains more than 900 hand-painted frames moving together to “create illusions of space and distance, to learn how to conjure the ineffable through the mere aggregation of lines and dots and stretch canvas.”
